_comment: Cross-boundary arbiter fixture (debt #284) for the admixture canonical key: '<soil_code>:<canonical_amount>' with the amount-step synonyms S->V (sterk = veel) and Z->W (zwak = weinig), owner ruling 2026-09-06. IMPORTANT: unlike the section-corridor and packing-class-key twins, this key is CURRENTLY PYTHON-ONLY. Admixture.canonical_key() / canonical_amount() live only in the backend (Accept find-or-create, auto-correlate ranking, litho formation lookup); the renderer sends RAW admixtures {soil_code, amount, locally} to the API and the backend computes the key, so no TypeScript twin exists today. The renderer's buildSeamClassOf is amount-INDEPENDENT by design (soil codes only) and is a different concept, NOT this key's twin. This fixture is read by tests/unit/domain/value_objects/test_twin_admixture_canonical_key.py and is the ready arbiter the moment a renderer needs the same key: add desktop/.../admixtureCanonicalKey.twin.test.ts against this same file and drift becomes cross-language-caught, exactly as debt #284 asks. The locally flag is intentionally excluded from the key.
